column1: # tklist-codes.tsv: SSX 3 event id -> Tricky TP preview file code.
# Consumed by tools/ssx3/tricky_atlas.py (--codes; defaults here) and passed
# to tools/ssx3/build_tk_list_art.py. Facts only (short names, same class as
# MANIFEST_ROWS in the driver): the codes are the stock event filecodes
# (RAM 0x442950 table); the TP files are DATA/UI/TP<code>.SSH on the user's
# Tricky disc. Megaplex (event 15) has no preview on disc and is
# intentionally absent (text card). Lives beside the atlas step (NOT under
# tools/ssx3/tricky/) so it stays out of the Tricky converter table.
